name: 圣代甜甜
evolution: 脆筒甜甜 → 香草甜甜 Lv.28 → 圣代甜甜 Lv.40
description: 喜欢群居的团结者，圣代甜甜诞生时就生有两颗冰淇淋球，相生相伴，两颗冰淇淋球口味性格不同却能一直融洽相处。
descriptionEn: A sociable uniter, Shengdaitiantian is born with two ice cream scoops that accompany each other; the two scoops have different flavors and personalities yet get along harmoniously.

skills.name: 霜降
skills.descriptionEn: The enemy gains 4 layers of Freeze.

skills.name: 风吹雪
skills.description: 造成魔伤，自己回复1能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage, restores 1 energy to self.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%, responds to attacks.

skills.name: 寒风吹
skills.description: 造成魔伤，敌方获得魔防-50%。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage, enemy gains M.DEF -50%.

skills.name: 暴风雪
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方获得1层冻结。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, enemy gains 1 layer of Freeze.

skills.name: 雾气环绕
skills.description: 回复能量，回复值等于敌方技能总能耗的一半。
skills.descriptionEn: Restores energy, the amount equal to half of the enemy's total skill cost.

skills.name: 冰晶坠
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方获得全技能能耗+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, enemy gains +1 to all skill costs.

skills.name: 霜天
skills.description: 敌方获得1层冻结，且每有1层冻结获得全技能能耗+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Enemy gains 1 layer of Freeze, and for each layer of Freeze gains +1 to all skill costs.

skills.name: 碎冰冰
skills.description: 造成魔伤，敌方每有1层冻结，本次技能威力+20。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage, for each layer of Freeze on enemy, this skill's power +20.

skills.name: 冰点
skills.description: 敌方获得5层冻结，应对防御：额外获得5层。
skills.descriptionEn: Enemy gains 5 layers of Freeze, responds to Defense: additionally gains 5 layers.

skills.name: 冰锋横扫
skills.description: 造成魔伤，本技能威力等于敌方精灵技能总能耗的10倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage, this skill's power equals 10 times the enemy's total skill cost.

skills.name: 冰雹
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：额外使敌方获得全技能能耗+3。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, responds to status: additionally makes enemy gain +3 to all skill costs.

skills.name: 极寒领域
skills.description: 造成魔伤，若敌方有冻结，本次技能威力+60，应对状态：使冻结翻倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage, if enemy is Frozen, this skill's power +60, responds to status: doubles Freeze.
